title: Advice-size polynomial bound
statement:
For all natural numbers $k,K,c,c_0,C,d,n$, we have
\[
n+C(n+1)^d+2+(c_0(n^c+1)+1)\bigl(k(2(c_0(n^c+1))+1)+(2n+2+C(n+1)^d)+3\bigr)K\leq \bigl(C+3+(2c_0+1)(k(4c_0+1)+C+7)K\bigr)(n+1)^{2(c+d+1)}.
\]
